description: Turns supplied real captures into a report receipt; it does not inspect a page or generate feedback. A web Crit requires both desktop and mobile captures for every logical screen and the exact Pincushion AI pin IDs the critic just created, each positioned in a supplied capture. Set purpose:"capture" only for an explicitly capture-only report.

accessMode.description: Public reports are anyone-with-link. Private reports require authenticated Pincushion project membership for images and findings.

coverage.description: Headless discovery and capture coverage summary; incomplete or gated routes remain explicit.

critiquePinIds.description: Required for purpose:"critique": exact Pincushion AI annotation IDs created by this run. Every ID must appear in pinPositions for a supplied capture.

critiqueRunId.description: Required for purpose:"critique": a stable ID shared by every critic pin in this run. The generated Crit receives a unique immutable generation key derived from it.

generationKey.description: Default canonical; stable key makes refreshes idempotent. owner-workspace is reserved for private browser captures.

screenIds.description: Explicit ordered logical screen IDs. Do not infer from arbitrary pages.

purpose.description: Defaults to critique. capture is for a truthful screenshot/report without AI findings.

reportUrl.description: Existing /r URL only for purpose:"capture" refreshes. A Crit always mints and binds its own new verified link.

flowColumn.description: Zero-based horizontal position in the Flow canvas.

flowRow.description: Zero-based vertical position in the Flow canvas.

links.description: Logical screen IDs directly reachable from this screen.

logicalScreenId.description: Stable identity grouping responsive captures of one logical screen.

navigationLabel.description: Human-readable navigation label for this screen.

navigationRole.description: Whether this screen is a navigation source or destination.
